test_cases.zig_test_name: TC-EE-07-04: PARALLEL_JOIN event records branch_id with edge_index 0 as outgoing_token_id
test_cases.description: Normal 2-branch join: both tokens arrive → join fires, 1 outgoing token; merged branch_id is deterministic

test_cases.zig_test_name: TC-EE-07-01: join waits when one branch cancelled, fires when remaining active branch arrives
test_cases.description: Cancelled-branch exclusion: 1 of 2 branches cancelled, remaining arrives → join fires (threshold = 1)

test_cases.zig_test_name: TC-EE-07-03: all-branches-cancelled path → INSTANCE_CANCELLED event, status CANCELLED
test_cases.description: All branches cancelled → INSTANCE_CANCELLED event, instance CANCELLED status

test_cases.zig_test_name: TC-EE-07-04: PARALLEL_JOIN event records branch_id with edge_index 0 as outgoing_token_id
test_cases.description: Exactly-once: both tokens present with reversed arrival order → 1 merge, 1 PARALLEL_JOIN event

test_cases.zig_test_name: TC-EE-07-05: 3-branch join — all 3 active branches arrive via task_completed → join fires, 1 outgoing token
test_cases.description: 3-branch join: all 3 active branches arrive via task_completed events → join fires once, 1 outgoing token

additional_coverage.zig_test_name: TC-EE-07-02: join still waits when only 1 of 2 active branches has arrived
additional_coverage.description: Wait path: only 1 of 2 active branches arrived → join waits, no event emitted
